_comment: App sourcetype -> the Elastic integration data stream the Elastic `cribl` integration reroutes it to. Read by src/elastic-integration.ts. dataId = the app's canonical sourcetype, so the route_entries the app renders and the _dataId the pack stamps always agree. `via: cribl` = the integration's ingest pipeline parses `message` itself, so the cribl integration can feed it. `via: agent` = parsing happens in Elastic Agent (Winlogbeat winlog.*, decode_cef, an S3 object path), so nothing Cribl sends parses: no route is stamped and the card says to use Elastic Agent. `expects` = the line shape the dataset's own ingest pipeline parses (a JS regex, matched per line); `fit` = whether the app's reference sample for the sourcetype has that shape, checked by tests/elastic-integration-test.mjs. Verified 2026-10-01 against each package's data_stream/<ds>/elasticsearch/ingest_pipeline/default.yml (elastic/integrations main).

checkpoint_firewall.shape: Log Exporter syslog format (RFC 5424 structured data, key:"value";)
checkpoint_firewall.note: The pipe-delimited Log Exporter export (key=value|key=value) is not parsed: set the Log Exporter format to syslog.

infoblox_dns.shape: NIOS syslog with <priority> and the member IP after the hostname
infoblox_dns.note: Every grok pattern is anchored on ^<priority>: a line forwarded without its syslog priority is not parsed.

zscaler_web.shape: NSS web feed in JSON output format
zscaler_web.note: The ZIA pipelines json-parse the line: a key=value or CSV NSS feed is not parsed. Set the NSS feed output type to JSON.

f5_bigip.note: The pipeline json-parses the line (ASM CEF aside): plain BIG-IP syslog is not parsed.

okta_system.shape: one Okta System Log event as JSON

aws_cloudtrail.shape: one CloudTrail record as JSON (not a Records[] file)

aws_vpc_v5.shape: VPC flow log line in a default field order (v2-v5 and the ECS variant)

gcp_audit.shape: one Cloud Audit LogEntry as JSON

zeek_conn.note: The pipeline json-parses the whole line: strip a syslog header before sending, or the event is dropped.

cisco_esa.note: The log category comes from the syslog tag or the file name: a bare line lands without cisco_secure_email_gateway.log.category.

windows_security.note: The ingest pipeline reads winlog.* (Elastic Agent's Windows input), not event XML or text.

windows_application.note: The ingest pipeline reads winlog.* (Elastic Agent's Windows input), not event XML or text.

windows_system.note: The ingest pipeline reads winlog.* (Elastic Agent's Windows input), not event XML or text.

windows_sysmon.note: The ingest pipeline reads winlog.* (Elastic Agent's Windows input), not event XML or text.

windows_powershell.note: The ingest pipeline reads winlog.* (Elastic Agent's Windows input), not event XML or text.

cef.shape: cef.* fields decoded by Elastic Agent
cef.note: CEF is decoded by the agent's decode_cef processor; the cef.log ingest pipeline only post-processes cef.* fields.

cisco_umbrella.shape: Umbrella S3 export read by Elastic Agent
cisco_umbrella.note: Every parse step is gated on log.file.path (dnslogs/proxylogs/…), the S3 object key the agent's input sets.
